name: voice
description: Proxy to a standalone real-time STT + diarization server (Python). Bridges audio control commands and forwards transcript/speaker events to the bus.

default_subscriptions.description: Voice node control commands (e.g. enable/disable VAD, switch model). Sender pushes JSON; the Python sidecar honours it.

action.description: Control verb forwarded to the Python sidecar.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier; defaults to 'default' server-side.

default_subscriptions.description: Rename a tracked speaker. Payload: {speaker_id, new_name}.

name.description: New human-readable label for that speaker.

default_subscriptions.description: Merge two speaker IDs into one (manual disambiguation). Payload: {keep, drop}.

keep.description: Speaker ID to retain after the merge.

drop.description: Speaker ID to fold into 'keep'; subsequent events get re-attributed.
